content: In case of multi cast transmission, the PDU Router module shall call the upper layer module using <Up>_TpTxConfirmation after receiving the last PduR_<User:LoTp>TxConfirmation from the lower layer transport protocol mod- ules. The result parameter shall be E_OK if at least one PduR_<User:LoTp>Tx- Confirmation reported E_OK .

In case of multicast transmission, the PDU Router module shall call the upper layer module using <Up>_TpTxConfirmation after receiving the last PduR_<User:LoTp>TxConfirmation from the lower layer Transport Protocol mod- ules. The result parameter shall be E_OK if at least one PduR_<User:LoTp>Tx- Confirmation reported E_OK .
